title: proof_coverage reads clause keys from falsifier clauses
intention: proof_coverage's clause keys for a ticket whose falsifier carries clauses are str(n) of each clause, read as data with no regex, and every standing shape keys as before.
why: Measured 2026-11-05: cairn/tools/proof_coverage/proof_coverage.py:171 _falsifier_clauses reads proves_red text and segments it by (N) and lettered-run regex; a falsifier {clauses: [...]} has no proves_red and keys as [] today. The parent e4f02a1ceef5 makes the ticket plan JSON at the cast door (Akien 2026-11-05: 'should be json'); this reader must read the new shape before the door admits it.
traces_to: Law 4 and Law 1 via parent e4f02a1ceef5; RULE 1 (each reader's change lives in its own component).
how: _falsifier_clauses returns [str(c['n']) for c in falsifier['clauses']] when the falsifier is a dict carrying a clauses list, before the proves_red branch; red-first proof.
falsifier: (1) a ticket with falsifier {clauses: [{n:1,...},{n:2,...},{n:3,...}]} keys ['1','2','3']; (2) a decide line 'falsifier clause (4) is added by this line' still adds '4' on such a ticket; (3) over every ticket in CairnCommons/tickets/ whose falsifier carries no clauses, the keys equal those at HEAD (fixture snapshot taken in the red-first commit).

decisions.text: Red-first proof cairn/tools/proof_coverage/proofs/test_clause_keys_come_from_falsifier_clauses.py, check()/FAILURES/main() shape, one tooth per falsifier clause, PROVES = {'ab32ccdc4504': {'1': 'clause_1', '2': 'clause_2', '3': 'clause_3', '4': 'clause_4'}} (tooth names written at build, each named for its clause). Red at HEAD on the new-shape teeth.
